name: slack-humanizer
description: Draft Slack messages that read as if the user typed them, and post them as rich text so lists render as real Slack lists.

interface.shortDescription: Slack messages in the user's voice, with real lists
interface.longDescription: Drafts Slack messages sent under the user's name in a short, direct, properly capitalized voice, strips the patterns that give away AI drafting, and builds a rich_text payload so bullets and numbered lists render as real Slack lists. A private voice profile can override the default voice.
defaultPrompt: Draft a Slack reply for me with the slack-humanizer skill.
